name: recallum-memory
description: Persistent, project-aware memory for Claude Code through Recallum. Loads concise project context at session start, recalls prior decisions on demand, and preserves newly settled preferences, constraints, decisions, and facts.

mcp_url.title: Recallum endpoint
mcp_url.description: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint of your own Recallum server, e.g. https://recallum.example.com/mcp/ . Keep the trailing slash: without it the server answers 307 to a plain-HTTP URL, and the redirect either leaks the bearer token in cleartext or drops it.

api_token.title: Recallum API key
api_token.description: API key for your Recallum server. Leave empty only if RECALLUM_API_KEY is exported in the environment that launches the client; with neither set, every tool call fails authentication.
